Runtime notices

This game bundles unmodified Pyodide 0.27.7, including CPython 3.12.7.
The original runtime bytes were verified against the npm package integrity
record and are served from /runtime/v0.27.7/.

Pyodide source: https://github.com/pyodide/pyodide/tree/0.27.7
Pyodide license: PYODIDE-LICENSE.txt (Mozilla Public License 2.0)
CPython source: https://github.com/python/cpython/tree/v3.12.7
Python license and historical notices: PYTHON-LICENSE.txt

No changes were made to the upstream interpreter or runtime distribution.
The educational runner, lessons, and game code are separate application files.
Additional notices incorporated in the upstream distribution remain intact.

The Pipi and Tangyuan images were supplied by the project owner. They are not
part of the Pyodide distribution or licensed by these runtime notices.
